description: This plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents training time in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds and tick labels at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents loss, also with a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot shows two lines: the purple line with triangle markers, representing the Vanilla model, starts at a loss of approximately 2.73 at 0 seconds and decreases to around 2.47 at 250,000 seconds, with a relatively steady decline across the training time; the red line with circular markers, representing SepLLM, begins at a loss of about 2.71 at 0 seconds and drops to roughly 2.45 at 250,000 seconds, also showing a consistent decrease in loss over the training time. Both lines exhibit a similar trend of decreasing loss as training time increases, with the SepLLM line consistently below the Vanilla line.
